svg.title: Food — Full Map — Observed Panned View
svg.desc: Editable reconstruction from food-165258-full-map-panned-pointer-on-header.png. Only the actual public map viewport crop (0,100,576,970), converted to sRGB, is raster. This source contains the pointer on the header, so the header is fully rebuilt with native text and Back; pointer and hover are omitted. Map callout, venue marker and partly visible Locate control are native editable elements where present. All remaining map place labels are part of public map artwork. The actual full-screen map viewport did not display a Google attribution; no visible attribution is removed and no attribution is fabricated. This is a static observed map state, not a claim of working geolocation or free-form map pan in the prototype. No map content cropped to hide the pointer and no synthetic replacement map.
